A policy-following assistant would most likely **not extend this box**. The request is still pending, and the next approval sitting is tomorrow; neither the booking nor the contact notes change the storage date. With the manager directing the full batch to be released on time, it would mark the record reviewed and include the box in today’s destruction manifest. It would then be collected at 14:30 and destroyed.

That is the likely procedural outcome, despite the notes making clear that the contents are irreplaceable.
